PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return to Movement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY private

GOALS
GOAL primary recovery
name "Restore pelvic floor and deep core function safely"
END GOAL
GOAL secondary mobility
name "Rebuild whole-body mobility and postural endurance"
END GOAL
GOAL tertiary strength
name "Gradually reintroduce bodyweight strength from week seven onward"
END GOAL
END GOALS

PHASES
PHASE "Phase 1 — Gentle Reactivation" (2 weeks)
WEEK 1
DAY Monday active_recovery 20m "Breathing and pelvic floor"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rest 30 seconds
pelvic_tilt 3x10 rest 30 seconds
cat_cow 3x8 rest 30 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
child_pose 60 seconds
forward_fold 30 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Wednesday active_recovery 20m "Gentle mobility"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rest 30 seconds
cat_cow 3x8 rest 30 seconds
bird_dog 3x6 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
child_pose 60 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Friday active_recovery 20m "Walking and breath"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rest 30 seconds
pelvic_tilt 3x10 rest 30 seconds
dead_bug 3x4 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
spinal_twist 30 seconds
child_pose 60 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
END WEEK
WEEK 2
DAY Monday active_recovery 25m "Breathing and pelvic floor progression"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rest 30 seconds
pelvic_tilt 3x12 rest 30 seconds
cat_cow 3x10 rest 30 seconds
dead_bug 3x5 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
child_pose 60 seconds
hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Wednesday active_recovery 25m "Mobility and glute intro"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rest 30 seconds
bird_dog 3x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
figure_four_stretch 30 seconds
spinal_twist 30 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Friday active_recovery 25m "Full Phase 1 session"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rest 30 seconds
pelvic_tilt 3x12 rest 30 seconds
dead_bug 3x6 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
cat_cow 3x10 rest 30 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
child_pose 60 seconds
hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
forward_fold 30 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
END WEEK
END PHASE

PHASE "Phase 2 — Foundation Building" (4 weeks)
WEEK 3
DAY Monday training 30m "Lower body and core foundation"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes
cat_cow 2x8
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rest 30 seconds
dead_bug 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
bird_dog 3x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
figure_four_stretch 30 seconds
child_pose 60 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Wednesday training 30m "Mobility and posture"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes
arm_circles 2x10
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rest 30 seconds
cat_cow 3x10 rest 30 seconds
bird_dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds

prone_Y 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds

COOLDOWN

shoulder_stretch 30 seconds

END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Friday training 30m "Glute and hip focus"

MAIN straight_sets

WEEK 4
